bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, twelve phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.7 (Catalog tags) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.7's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `Catalog.tag` and `Catalog.untag` add and remove one tag on a book without duplicates (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_tags`)
`tag_counts` counts books per tag, sorted by tag (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_tag_counts`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `Catalog.tag` and `Catalog.untag` are added to shelf/catalog.py and tested in tests/test_tags.py.
tag adds a tag at most once and untag removes it; the book's tags stay a list, so storage writes them unchanged.
Both look the book up through Catalog.get, so either ISBN form works and an unknown book raises NotFound.
`tag_counts` counts books per tag, sorted by tag, tested in tests/test_tag_counts.py.
A tag's count in tag_counts equals len(Catalog.by_tag(tag)).
storage.FORMAT stays 2; tasks touch only shelf/ and tests/.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
